title: Concrete Godement operators respect the simplex relations
statement: For a scheme X and an O_X-module F, let T, the iterates T^(n+1)(F), the insertion maps and the collapse maps be the concrete constructions of [def-sc-module-cup-godement-model] and [def-sc-module-cup-godement-codegeneracies]. Send the object n of the free simplex quiver to T^(n+1)(F), delta_i to insertion_i, and sigma_i to collapse_i. The induced path functor sends every pair related by FreeSimplexQuiver.homRel to equal morphisms of X.Modules. Thus all six simplex relations hold for the actual operators, without assuming existence of a cosimplicial object.

proof.text: Project to each point coordinate and use skyscraperHomEquiv. Define e_F,x as skyscraperStalkEval composed with the stalk map of the product projection. The adjunction gives e_F,x after the unit equal to identity, e_G,x after T(f) equal to f_x after e_F,x, and e_F,x after multiplication equal to e_F,x after e_T(F),x. These identities prove that T respects identity and composition, that unit and multiplication are natural, both multiplication-unit identities, and multiplication associativity. Each helper is proved in Lean by product extensionality, stalk functoriality, and the stated adjunction inverse laws.

Induct on the outer iterate, splitting each Fin index into zero and successor. Successor indices reduce to the induction hypothesis under T, using its composition and identity laws. A zero coface with a later operator uses unit naturality; a zero collapse with a later operator uses multiplication naturality. The two adjacent coface-collapse equations use the two unit laws. Adjacent collapses use associativity. The order bounds rule out zero indices on the wrong side. This proves insert_insert, insert_collapse_le, insert_collapse_self, insert_collapse_succ, insert_collapse_gt and collapse_collapse. Finally case split on the six constructors of homRel and simplify the lifted path maps.

lean.statement:
theorem moduleCup_godement_relations (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules) :
    ∀ (a b : Paths FreeSimplexQuiver) (f g : a ⟶ b),
      FreeSimplexQuiver.homRel f g →
        (Paths.lift (moduleCup_godementQuiver X F)).map f =
          (Paths.lift (moduleCup_godementQuiver X F)).map g
